description: Land Acquisition - The Land Compensation of Naththambura,  Rambukkana D/S Division, Kegalle District
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of land acquisition notices published under the Land Acquisition Act. It details specific land parcels being acquired, including their locations, lot numbers, extents, and compensation values deposited for landowners. The content falls squarely under "Land and property-related matters" including "land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as defined for Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
